scenario: 5 kaggle-cs documents deleted directly from Elasticsearch (kaggle-cs in index 20 675 -> 20 670), then a regular kaggle-cs replay through Ingestion -> corpus.store -> Content transaction + outbox -> search.index -> search_worker

idempotency.note: redelivery overwrites with version_type=external_gte; Mongo duplicates ($setOnInsert) still emit events, so a replay also repairs the index

caveat: A direct DELETE bumps the ES version; within index.gc_deletes (60 s) a version-1 event would be reported as stale, so the replay was started 65 s after deleting.
